data.value: This is an estimate, not a promise to free the stated amount. Contents were not read and files were not deleted. Cleanup re-evaluates candidates; a file may change or be locked. Sizes are logical, not physical space used on the storage device.

data.name: Review.Report.TempCleanupReady
data.value: Cleanup is available as the separately confirmed CleanTemp action in the main window. The largest-files list is not a deletion plan.

data.name: Review.Report.TempCleanupUnavailable
data.value: For deletion, run the program normally as the user of this session. Being able to read while elevated does not imply cleanup is available in the same context.

data.name: Review.Report.StartupBoundary
data.value: Commands are shown without execution or variable expansion. Enabled state is not determined; signature, reputation, and startup impact are not checked.

data.name: Review.Report.Footer
data.value: Export contains the entire saved snapshot regardless of the window search filter. Paths and commands may contain sensitive data. Do not publish the report without review.
